# Geoporte

> Geoporte is an engineering design consultancy providing civil, geotechnical, structural, stormwater, project controls, advisory and telecom engineering services, with offices in Melbourne, Sydney, Perth (Australia) and Auckland (New Zealand).

Contact: enquiries@geoporte.com.au · +61 (0) 431 55 4626 (Australia) · +64 (0) 212 87 0714 (New Zealand). Head office: Tower 5, Collins Square, 727 Collins Street, Melbourne VIC 3008.

## Company
- [Home](https://geoporte.com.au/): Geoporte provides geotechnical, civil, structural and telecom engineering design consultancy across Australia and New Zealand, from investigation to delivery.
- [About Geoporte | Engineering Design Consultancy](https://geoporte.com.au/about-us): Learn about Geoporte, a multidisciplinary engineering consultancy delivering risk-based civil, geotechnical and telecom design across Australia and New Zealand.
- [Leadership | Managing Director](https://geoporte.com.au/leadership): Senior engineering leadership on every project, from first conversation to final design. Meet Geoporte’s Managing Director, Qaiser Hayat.
- [Projects | Transport, Energy & Water](https://geoporte.com.au/projects): Explore projects delivered by Geoporte specialists across transport, built environment, energy, resources and water in Australia, NZ, the UAE and the UK.
- [Publications & Technical Papers](https://geoporte.com.au/publications): Conference presentations and technical papers by Geoporte specialists on digital transformation in geotechnics and tunnelling projects in Melbourne.
- [Contact Us](https://geoporte.com.au/contact-us): Send Geoporte an enquiry or contact the Melbourne, Sydney, Perth, Auckland and Austin offices by email or phone.

## Services
- [Engineering Advisory Services](https://geoporte.com.au/advisory-services): Civil and geotechnical advisory: feasibility studies, risk management, regulatory compliance, construction and asset management, from concept to completion.
- [Civil Engineering Design Services](https://geoporte.com.au/civil-engineering): Practical, sustainable civil engineering design: earthworks, roads, pavements, stormwater drainage, culverts and water infrastructure, concept to construction.
- [Design & Drafting Services | AutoCAD, Civil 3D](https://geoporte.com.au/design-and-drafting): Civil design and drafting using AutoCAD, Civil 3D and Revit: conceptual and detailed design, 3D modelling, site grading and construction documentation.
- [Project Control Services | Cost & Schedule](https://geoporte.com.au/project-control-services): Project controls for civil projects: cost estimating, Primavera P6 scheduling, risk management, change control, earned value management and reporting.
- [Stormwater & Flood Modelling Services](https://geoporte.com.au/stormwater-and-flood-modelling): Hydrological, hydraulic and GIS-based flood modelling, flood hazard mapping, stormwater management plans and climate change adaptation for infrastructure.
- [Structural Engineering Design Services](https://geoporte.com.au/structural-engineering): Customised, cost-effective structural engineering for civil infrastructure, from conceptual and detailed design to 3D modelling and construction documentation.
- [Telecom Engineering Services | RF Design & DAS](https://geoporte.com.au/telecom-services): Surveys, RF design, installation and optimisation of mobile networks, including in-building DAS, small cells, repeaters and outdoor macro and PSN sites.

## Geotechnical engineering services
- [Desktop Studies & Geohazard Assessment](https://geoporte.com.au/desktop-studies-and-geohazard-geotechnical-assessment): Desktop geotechnical, geological and geomorphological studies and geohazard assessment to guide feasibility, planning and acquisition of infrastructure sites.
- [Earthworks Design & AS3798 Testing](https://geoporte.com.au/earthworks-design): Earthworks design and consulting: working platforms, compaction control, Level 1 and 2 AS3798 inspection and testing, expansive clays and residual soils.
- [Forensic Geotechnical Engineering](https://geoporte.com.au/forensic-geotechnical-engineering-including-investigations-of-geotechnical-failures): Investigation of settlement, cracking, movement and collapse in foundations and geotechnical structures, with cause evaluation and repair recommendations.
- [Ground Improvement Design](https://geoporte.com.au/ground-improvement-design): Ground improvement design for soft and loose soils: dynamic compaction, vibro methods, stone columns, deep soil mixing, grouting, preloading and PVDs.
- [Ground Settlement Analysis (Static & Seismic)](https://geoporte.com.au/ground-settlement-static-and-seismic): Analysis, design and monitoring for ground settlement and subsidence, including consolidation, creep and differential settlement, and seismic effects.
- [Geotechnical Numerical Modelling | PLAXIS & FEM](https://geoporte.com.au/numerical-modelling): Advanced 2D and 3D numerical modelling of complex geotechnical problems by experienced engineers, for practical and cost-effective design solutions.
- [Pavement Design | CIRCLY & Austroads](https://geoporte.com.au/pavement-profile-design): Pavement design for residential and commercial roads and arterials, with CIRCLY analysis and compliance with Austroads, VicRoads and council guidelines.
- [Pipeline Load Impact Assessment](https://geoporte.com.au/pipelines): Numerical assessment of fill and vehicle loading on existing water and fuel pipelines, with design of protection works where damage is predicted.
- [Geotechnical Proof Engineering & Design Review](https://geoporte.com.au/proof-engineering-services-of-geotechnical-design): Independent proof engineering and review of geotechnical designs for buildings, roads, bridges, deep tunnels and ventilation shafts, delivered collaboratively.
- [Land & Marine Reclamation Works Design](https://geoporte.com.au/reclamation-works-design): Design of land and marine reclamation works: ground investigation scoping, performance specifications, ground improvement and compaction compliance testing.
- [Retaining Wall & Retention Systems Design](https://geoporte.com.au/retention-systems): Design and proof engineering of sheet piled, diaphragm, bored pile and gravity retaining walls based on robust soil-structure interaction analysis.
- [Road Subgrade Assessment & Design](https://geoporte.com.au/road-subgrade-assessment-and-design): Subgrade investigation and design parameters for flexible and rigid pavements, subgrade improvement and evaluation of existing roads for asphalt overlay.
- [Seismic Hazard Analysis & Earthquake Design](https://geoporte.com.au/seismic-hazard-analyses-and-earthquake-geotechnical-design): Probabilistic seismic hazard analysis, liquefaction studies, detailed seismic assessment and earthquake design of foundations, walls, earthworks and slopes.
- [Geotechnical Site Investigation & Reporting](https://geoporte.com.au/site-investigation-planning-and-reporting): Planning, supervision and reporting of geotechnical site investigations: drilling, sampling, test pits, in situ testing, laboratory testing and seismic surveys.
- [Slope Stability Assessment & Stabilisation](https://geoporte.com.au/slope-stability-assessment-and-design-of-slope-stabilization-works): Slope stability risk assessments for residential lots and developments, including Landslide Hazard and Steep Land Overlay areas, and stabilisation design.
- [Geotechnical Temporary Works Design](https://geoporte.com.au/temporary-works-design): Temporary works design for excavation retention, cut slopes, piling and crane platforms, cofferdams and hardstands, with construction stage monitoring.
